preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has n between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r_i <= 10**9 for r_i in [int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each r_i is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= r_i for r_i, c_i in zip([int(x) for x in line.split()], [int(x) for x in line.split()]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::2])
preconditions.description: Each c_i is an integer between 1 and r_i inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(zip(r_list, c_list))) == len(r_list) for r_list, c_list in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::2]]))
preconditions.description: All points in each test case are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == str(min_cost) for output_line, min_cost in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [compute_min_cost(r_list, c_list) for r_list, c_list in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::2]])]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum cost of a path passing through all points in arbitrary order.
